TRUMP SIGNALS POSSIBLE NEW STRIKES ON IRAN AFTER NEW YEAR

President Donald Trump says he is “inclined to” resume military strikes against Iran after January 1 if ongoing negotiations fail to produce an agreement.

Speaking to Fox News, Trump confirmed that indirect talks remain underway but criticized Tehran for prolonging negotiations without results.

He also issued a stark warning over the Strait of Hormuz, threatening to sink Iranian vessels if they challenge the U.S. naval blockade.

No decision to launch new strikes has been announced.
